theme: Exposing a pattern smaller than the light
title: Printing Smaller Than the Light: Mask Pre-Distortion
strategies: identity: draw the mask exactly as the target pattern (the obvious approach)
uniform bias: dilate every target pixel by a fixed Chebyshev radius (textbook CD-bias correction, blind to local density)
single-dose model-based correction: locally search the mask against the known optical model but only for the nominal dose
process-window local search: locally search the mask against the known optical model jointly across all three doses, trading mean fidelity against worst-dose fidelity
